title: Factors of Whole Numbers up to 48
seo_title: Factors – Primary 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find factors of whole numbers up to 48; find missing factors; tell factors from other numbers. (summary of the NERDC Primary 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 maths worksheets on factors: factors of numbers up to 48, missing factors, all the factors of a number, and numbers that are not factors. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A factor of a number divides it exactly, with nothing left over.
  • Factors come in pairs: 24 = 1 × 24 = 2 × 12 = 3 × 8 = 4 × 6.
  • 1 is a factor of every number, and every number is a factor of itself.

Examples

Example

Factors of 18

1 × 18, 2 × 9, 3 × 6

Answer: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting 1 and the number itselfThey are always factors.
Listing multiples instead of factorsFactors are smaller than or equal to the number.
Missing a pairTry 1, 2, 3, 4, … in order.
